fx_assumption.rate_basis: Illustrative static FX assumption for converting EUA EUR auction prices into GBP
fx_assumption.notes: Used for public demo only; not a live FX feed

carbon.currency_note: EUA EUR auction prices are converted to GBP using a static EUR/GBP assumption of 0.86. The resulting UKA-EUA spread is shown in GBP and is a transparent auction-context indicator, not a live traded spread.
carbon.alignment_note: UKA auction dates are compared with the nearest official EUA auction date within 14 days because UKA and EUA auction calendars differ.
carbon.limitation: Carbon market data uses official/public or curated auction inputs rather than licensed live UKA/EUA price feeds.

power.commentary: Carbon intensity reflects the physical emissions profile of the GB power system; contractual renewable supply depends on certificate ownership and disclosure rules.
